overwrite_policy: refuse; repairs require fresh protocol or evidence identifiers
required_artifacts: at least 24 and at most 48 attempt files
stage-specific transmission authorizations and rater custody
bindings: all frozen source and prior-publication hashes
model manifest, config, model, template, and license layer hashes
request and raw API-body hashes per observation
stage-specific authorization, calibration, rubric, packets, prompts, event logs, raw rater outputs, and session hashes
each result path, byte size, and SHA-256
